description: available through the CLI: every trusted source of the merged map in its order, each item a line of ✓ (or a blank), type, name@source and ` — <description>` when it has one, its bundles after its items, each with its members on a second line. An item is ✓ when an explicit entry of either scope declares it or a lock of either scope holds it for that source – under any target (a codex: key), not when it rendered empty – a bundle when a scope's config declares it. A user source is read by the user config's definition (the project's local override is not read), a git source fetched into the cache; a project-only source is skipped until trusted, by name too (an empty line, --json []), then listed; one source by name; --json the list; with --project-dir the home only the user config's sources and lock count. Nothing is written but the cache.
